the authorities were initially reluctant to adopt a policy of dear money because they believed it to be ineffective and because they feared that it might be inflationary; that they came to adopt it because of the belief, held by the Governor of the Bank of England, that the economy was on the verge of a dangerous inflationary spiral; and that they came to believe that the economy was in danger because of the mistaken belief that the economy was already in an inflationary spiral.
